structuredEvidence.definition: properly, a circlet , i.e. a diadem

firstOccurrence.englishText: to bring Vashti the queen before the king with the royal crown, to show the people and the princes her beauty; for she was beautiful.

timeline.evidenceText: to bring Vashti the queen before the king with the royal crown, to show the people and the princes her beauty; for she was beautiful.

The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown on her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
let royal clothing be brought which the king uses to wear, and the horse that the king rides on, and on the head of which a royal crown is set.
